21: ## HydroHarvest NFT
22: 
23: Aplicación 3D recuperada desde el repositorio PLAYGROUND. Simulá un emprendimiento hidropónico, diseñá módulos NFT y compará otros sistemas, cultivos, costos y cosechas. Pensada para escritorio y pantallas táctiles.
24:

26: 
27: Necesitás Python 3 (o cualquier servidor estático). Desde la raíz:
28: 
29: ```sh
30: python3 -m http.server 8000
31: ```
32: 
33: Abrí <http://localhost:8000>. La partida se guarda localmente en el navegador; no se requiere instalación de dependencias ni conexión a un backend.
34:

275:

🌱 1 · Plantar

Tocá una cama y elegí un cultivo. Hay seis sistemas bien distintos: canaleta NFT, balsa DWC, bandeja ebb & flow, bateas holandesas, torres aeropónicas y estantes Kratky pasivos. Cada uno tiene su costo, consumo de agua, energía y cantidad de plantas.

276:

📐 2 · Modo plano

El botón 📐 activa el plano técnico: grilla en metros, medidas del invernadero, contadores de tubos y plantas por cama, y etiquetas con días para cosechar. Es la vista para entender la geometría real de cada sistema.

277:

💧 3 · Cuidado semana a semana

Cada cama muestra su checklist semanal: medir pH/EC, rellenar, revisar raíces y un chequeo propio del sistema. Completar tareas da salud y crecimiento. Mantené pH 5,5–6,5 y EC dentro de la banda del cultivo. El Auto-Dosificador automatiza medición y relleno.

278:

📅 4 · Tiempo y cosecha

Los cultivos duran 2 a 6 semanas (1 semana = 7 días de juego). El panel de la cama muestra el cronograma con la semana actual y los días que faltan para cosechar. El Panel temporal (P) suma gráficos de caja, kilos cosechados, un Gantt de todas las camas y un registro de eventos.

279:

📈 5 · Vender y comparar

Cosechá al depósito y vendé en el Mercado o cumplí Pedidos premium. La pestaña Rentabilidad del laboratorio compara resultados reales, margen, repago y $/m²/semana de cada sistema.

280:

🧪 6 · Explorar sistemas

En el laboratorio, cada ficha tiene una vista 3D giratoria: arrastrá para rotar el sistema y entender cómo se arma. También podés rotar el invernadero con los botones ⟲ ⟳ o con Q/E.

281:

🤖 7 · Asesor IA

El Asesor IA lee tu partida y te dice qué sistema conviene, cuánta agua y energía vas a consumir, qué cosechar primero y cómo escalar a más clientes. Su simulador de presupuesto combina un invernadero, un sistema y una cantidad de módulos para calcular inversión, costos semanales, ingreso estimado y repago. Es un motor de recomendaciones local: no manda tus datos a internet.

282:

🏗️ 8 · Modo Dios

Activalo desde el menú para construir sin límites: caja infinita, compras gratis, sin quiebra y sin colisiones. Ideal para probar todos los sistemas y comparar. Podés apagarlo cuando quieras.

1: # Rescate de HydroHarvest desde PLAYGROUND
2: 
3: Este repositorio conserva la aplicación de hidroponía NFT recuperada del repositorio `gamer-frog/PlayGround`, antes de que ese repositorio sea retirado.
4: 
5: ## Aplicación recuperada
6: 
7: - La versión completa más reciente está en la raíz: `index.html`, `css/`, `js/` y `vendor/three.min.js`.
8: - Corresponde al checkpoint `opencode-checkpoints/23` de PLAYGROUND (6 de noviembre de 2026). Incluye el simulador 3D HydroHarvest, seis sistemas hidropónicos, cultivos, presupuesto/mercado, construcción, eventos y controles táctiles.
9: - Se preservó también la versión modular anterior en `archive/hydroharvest-v1/` (checkpoint 2), con sus hojas de estilo, módulos JavaScript, iconos, manifest y Three.js modular. Es una referencia archivada y no forma parte del arranque actual.
10: - Los historiales de conversaciones originales de los checkpoints 1, 2, 3, 22 y 23 están comprimidos en `docs/history/`. Se incluyen para no perder especificaciones y decisiones que no quedaron plasmadas en el código.
11: 
12: ## Ejecutar
13: 
14: Es una aplicación estática. Desde la raíz del proyecto, iniciá un servidor HTTP local, por ejemplo:
15: 
16: ```sh
17: python3 -m http.server 8000
18: ```
19: 
20: Luego abrí `http://localhost:8000`. También se puede publicar como sitio estático. No usa paquetes externos de npm: Three.js está incluido en `vendor/three.min.js`.
21: 
22: ## Verificación
23: 
24: Los módulos JavaScript recuperados pasan `node --check`. La partida y las preferencias se guardan en el almacenamiento local del navegador. Los costos y rendimientos son supuestos de simulación para comparar diseños; no reemplazan cotizaciones ni asesoramiento agronómico local.
25: 
26: ## Procedencia
27: 
28: Los archivos principales se copiaron sin alterar su contenido desde el árbol del checkpoint 23 de PLAYGROUND. La implementación modular del checkpoint 2 se conserva separada para evitar mezclar dos versiones de la aplicación.

1: # Rescate de HydroHarvest desde PLAYGROUND
2: 
3: Este repositorio conserva la aplicación de hidroponía NFT recuperada del repositorio `gamer-frog/PlayGround`, antes de que ese repositorio sea retirado.
4: 
5: ## Aplicación recuperada
6: 
7: - La versión completa más reciente está en la raíz: `index.html`, `css/`, `js/` y `vendor/three.min.js`.
8: - Corresponde al checkpoint `opencode-checkpoints/23` de PLAYGROUND (6 de noviembre de 2026). Incluye el simulador 3D HydroHarvest, seis sistemas hidropónicos, cultivos, presupuesto/mercado, construcción, eventos y controles táctiles.
9: - Se preservó también la versión modular anterior en `archive/hydroharvest-v1/` (checkpoint 2), con sus hojas de estilo, módulos JavaScript, iconos, manifest y Three.js modular. Es una referencia archivada y no forma parte del arranque actual.
10: - Los historiales de conversaciones originales de los checkpoints 1, 2, 3, 22 y 23 están comprimidos en `docs/history/`. Se incluyen para no perder especificaciones y decisiones que no quedaron plasmadas en el código.
11: 
12: ## Ejecutar
13: 
14: Es una aplicación estática. Desde la raíz del proyecto, iniciá un servidor HTTP local, por ejemplo:
15: 
16: ```sh
17: python3 -m http.server 8000
18: ```
19: 
20: Luego abrí `http://localhost:8000`. También se puede publicar como sitio estático. No usa paquetes externos de npm: Three.js está incluido en `vendor/three.min.js`.
21: 
22: ## Verificación
23: 
24: Los módulos JavaScript recuperados pasan `node --check`. La partida y las preferencias se guardan en el almacenamiento local del navegador. Los costos y rendimientos son supuestos de simulación para comparar diseños; no reemplazan cotizaciones ni asesoramiento agronómico local.
25: 
26: ## Procedencia
27: 
28: Los archivos principales se copiaron sin alterar su contenido desde el árbol del checkpoint 23 de PLAYGROUND. La implementación modular del checkpoint 2 se conserva separada para evitar mezclar dos versiones de la aplicación.

MANUAL DEL CULTIVADOR

Cómo jugar

274:
275:

🌱 1 · Plantar

Tocá una cama y elegí un cultivo. Hay seis sistemas bien distintos: canaleta NFT, balsa DWC, bandeja ebb & flow, bateas holandesas, torres aeropónicas y estantes Kratky pasivos. Cada uno tiene su costo, consumo de agua, energía y cantidad de plantas.

276:

📐 2 · Modo plano

El botón 📐 activa el plano técnico: grilla en metros, medidas del invernadero, contadores de tubos y plantas por cama, y etiquetas con días para cosechar. Es la vista para entender la geometría real de cada sistema.

277:

💧 3 · Cuidado semana a semana

Cada cama muestra su checklist semanal: medir pH/EC, rellenar, revisar raíces y un chequeo propio del sistema. Completar tareas da salud y crecimiento. Mantené pH 5,5–6,5 y EC dentro de la banda del cultivo. El Auto-Dosificador automatiza medición y relleno.

278:

📅 4 · Tiempo y cosecha

Los cultivos duran 2 a 6 semanas (1 semana = 7 días de juego). El panel de la cama muestra el cronograma con la semana actual y los días que faltan para cosechar. El Panel temporal (P) suma gráficos de caja, kilos cosechados, un Gantt de todas las camas y un registro de eventos.

279:

📈 5 · Vender y comparar

Cosechá al depósito y vendé en el Mercado o cumplí Pedidos premium. La pestaña Rentabilidad del laboratorio compara resultados reales, margen, repago y $/m²/semana de cada sistema.

280:

🧪 6 · Explorar sistemas

En el laboratorio, cada ficha tiene una vista 3D giratoria: arrastrá para rotar el sistema y entender cómo se arma. También podés rotar el invernadero con los botones ⟲ ⟳ o con Q/E.

281:

🤖 7 · Asesor IA

El Asesor IA lee tu partida y te dice qué sistema conviene, cuánta agua y energía vas a consumir, qué cosechar primero y cómo escalar a más clientes. Su simulador de presupuesto combina un invernadero, un sistema y una cantidad de módulos para calcular inversión, costos semanales, ingreso estimado y repago. Es un motor de recomendaciones local: no manda tus datos a internet.

282:

🏗️ 8 · Modo Dios

Activalo desde el menú para construir sin límites: caja infinita, compras gratis, sin quiebra y sin colisiones. Ideal para probar todos los sistemas y comparar. Podés apagarlo cuando quieras.

283:

📱 Toque y teclado

Arrastrá para mover · pellizcá o rueda para zoom · tocá una cama · QE rotar. Espacio pausa · 1–6 velocidad / tarjeta de construcción · B construir · M mercado · C pedidos · U mejoras · Y sistemas · P panel · T plano · G objetivos · H ayuda · Esc cerrar/cancelar

messages.summary:
## Objective
- Convert Hydro_simulator into the user’s complete Spanish-language learning and visual business sandbox for hydroponics NFT, then keep improving the app in a Ralph-loop style.
- Recover Hydro-related branches from the original Playground repository and preserve them in the current GitHub repo.

## Requirements
- Sandbox should teach and visualize building a hydroponic business, including systems, variants, costs, materials, yields, customers, and profitability.
- User asked to recover Playground and Hydro branches; push progress to the repo as work is done.
- User requested extended iterative improvement (“Modo Ralph loop”).

## Decisions
- Identified `gamer-frog/PlayGround` as the source repository and added it as Git remote `playground`.
- Attempted to preserve source branches in `gamer-frog/Hydro_simulator` under `rescued/playground/*`.

## Work State
### Completed
- Confirmed the root app is the recovered HydroHarvest checkpoint 23, with older modular version and histories archived.
- Fetched all available `gamer-frog/PlayGround` branches into local remote-tracking refs `playground/*`.
- Pushed many Playground refs to `gamer-frog/Hydro_simulator` as `rescued/playground/*`.

### Active
- Continue improving HydroHarvest as a realistic, visual, educational business sandbox.
- Investigate and recover remaining source branches, including the user’s requested Hydro branches.

### Blocked
- Some Playground refs were rejected by GitHub because the GitHub App lacks `workflows` permission to create/update `.github/workflows/opencode.yml`; examples include `playground/opencode-checkpoints/1` and `/2`.
- `https://github.com/gamer-frog/Hydro.git` returned “Repository not found”; a separate Hydro repository/branch source remains unidentified.
- Push reported GitHub large-file warnings for `.omgithub/conversation.json` files exceeding 50 MB.

## Next Move
1. Inspect available local remotes/refs and determine which `rescued/playground/*` refs successfully landed; document skipped refs and permissions limitation.
2. Identify the intended “Hydro” repository/branches through available source context or GitHub URLs, without assuming `gamer-frog/Hydro.git`.
3. Start iterative Ralph-style improvements on the app, validating functionality and pushing incremental changes when possible.

## Relevant Files
- `docs/RESCUE_PLAYGROUND.md`: provenance and recovery scope for HydroHarvest.
- `docs/history/playground-checkpoint-23-conversation.json.gz`: original project requirements and decisions.
- `index.html`: current Spanish app interface and sandbox workflows.
- `js/game.js`: simulation, economy, systems, advisor, and interface logic.
- `js/world.js`: Three.js scene and visual system models.
- `js/data.js`: hydroponic system and crop data.
- `css/style.css`: app styling and mobile layout.

## Important Context
- Current app already includes six hydroponic systems, crop cycles, market/contracts, construction, budget/advisor, timeline/dashboard, mobile controls, and local saves.
- Git remotes: `origin=https://github.com/gamer-frog/Hydro_simulator`, `playground=https://github.com/gamer-frog/PlayGround`.
- Branch-preservation push partially succeeded; do not assume all Playground branches exist on `origin`.
- No app code changes were made during this exchange.

## Objective
- Turn Hydro_simulator into a Spanish-language learning and visual sandbox for building an NFT hydroponics business and related systems.
- Recover the user’s work and hydroponics branches from Playground and Hydro, then improve the app iteratively.

## Requirements
- Teach and visualize systems, variants, costs, materials, yields, customers, and profitability.
- Preserve recovered branches and push progress to the repository where possible.
- Continue improving the app in “Modo Ralph loop.”

## Decisions
- Identified `gamer-frog/PlayGround` as the source repository and added it as remote `playground`.
- Attempted to preserve Playground branches in `gamer-frog/Hydro_simulator` under `rescued/playground/*`.

## Work State
### Completed
- Fetched all available `gamer-frog/PlayGround` branches into local remote-tracking refs `playground/*`.
- Pushed the available Playground refs toward `origin` under `rescued/playground/*`; the push partially succeeded.

### Active
- Check which rescued branches landed on `origin`, and continue recovering source branches.
- Improve HydroHarvest as a realistic, visual, educational business sandbox.

### Blocked
- Some Playground refs were rejected because the GitHub App lacks `workflows` permission to create or update `.github/workflows/opencode.yml`.
- `https://github.com/gamer-frog/Hydro.git` returned `Repository not found`; the intended Hydro repository or branch source is unidentified.
- GitHub warned that some `.omgithub/conversation.json` files exceed 50 MB.

## Next Move
1. Compare local `playground/*` refs with `origin`’s `rescued/playground/*` refs and document any refs skipped due to permissions.
2. Identify the intended Hydro repository or branch source.
3. Begin iterative app improvements, validate functionality, and push progress where possible.

## Relevant Files
- `docs/RESCUE_PLAYGROUND.md`: provenance and recovery scope.
- `docs/history/`: archived original project conversations and requirements.
- `index.html`: current Spanish app interface.
- `js/game.js`: simulation, economy, systems, advisor, and interface logic.
- `js/world.js`: Three.js scene and system visuals.
- `js/data.js`: hydroponic system and crop data.
- `css/style.css`: app styling and mobile layout.

## Important Context
- The root app is HydroHarvest checkpoint 23, with an older modular version archived in `archive/hydroharvest-v1/`.
- The current app includes six hydroponic systems, crop cycles, market/contracts, construction, budget/advisor, timeline/dashboard, mobile controls, and local saves.
- Git remotes: `origin=https://github.com/gamer-frog/Hydro_simulator`, `playground=https://github.com/gamer-frog/PlayGround`.
- No app code changes were made in the latest exchange.

1: # Rescate de HydroHarvest desde PLAYGROUND
2: 
3: Este repositorio conserva la aplicación de hidroponía NFT recuperada del repositorio `gamer-frog/PlayGround`, antes de que ese repositorio sea retirado.
4: 
5: ## Aplicación recuperada
6: 
7: - La versión completa más reciente está en la raíz: `index.html`, `css/`, `js/` y `vendor/three.min.js`.
8: - Corresponde al checkpoint `opencode-checkpoints/23` de PLAYGROUND (6 de noviembre de 2026). Incluye el simulador 3D HydroHarvest, seis sistemas hidropónicos, cultivos, presupuesto/mercado, construcción, eventos y controles táctiles.
9: - Se preservó también la versión modular anterior en `archive/hydroharvest-v1/` (checkpoint 2), con sus hojas de estilo, módulos JavaScript, iconos, manifest y Three.js modular. Es una referencia archivada y no forma parte del arranque actual.
10: - Los historiales de conversaciones originales de los checkpoints 1, 2, 3, 22 y 23 están comprimidos en `docs/history/`. Se incluyen para no perder especificaciones y decisiones que no quedaron plasmadas en el código.
11: 
12: ## Ejecutar
13: 
14: Es una aplicación estática. Desde la raíz del proyecto, iniciá un servidor HTTP local, por ejemplo:
15: 
16: ```sh
17: python3 -m http.server 8000
18: ```
19: 
20: Luego abrí `http://localhost:8000`. También se puede publicar como sitio estático. No usa paquetes externos de npm: Three.js está incluido en `vendor/three.min.js`.
21: 
22: ## Verificación
23: 
24: Los módulos JavaScript recuperados pasan `node --check`. La partida y las preferencias se guardan en el almacenamiento local del navegador. Los costos y rendimientos son supuestos de simulación para comparar diseños; no reemplazan cotizaciones ni asesoramiento agronómico local.
25: 
26: ## Procedencia
27: 
28: Los archivos principales se copiaron sin alterar su contenido desde el árbol del checkpoint 23 de PLAYGROUND. La implementación modular del checkpoint 2 se conserva separada para evitar mezclar dos versiones de la aplicación.

## Objective
- Develop HydroHarvest into a Spanish-language learning and visual sandbox for building an NFT hydroponics business and related systems.
- Preserve recovered project history and improve the app iteratively.

## Requirements
- Teach and visualize systems, variants, costs, materials, yields, customers, and profitability.
- Preserve recovered branches and push progress where possible.
- Continue improving the app in “Modo Ralph loop.”

## Decisions
- Use `gamer-frog/PlayGround` as the recovery source and preserve its branches under `rescued/playground/*` where permissions allow.
- Keep the checkpoint 2 modular version archived separately from the current root app.

## Objective
- Develop HydroHarvest into a Spanish-language learning and visual sandbox for building an NFT hydroponics business and related systems.
- Preserve recovered project history and improve the app iteratively in “Modo Ralph loop.”

## Requirements
- Teach and visualize systems, variants, costs, materials, yields, customers, and profitability.
- Preserve recovered branches and push progress where possible.

## Decisions
- Use `gamer-frog/PlayGround` as the recovery source and preserve its branches under `rescued/playground/*` where permissions allow.
- Keep the checkpoint 2 modular version archived separately from the current root app.

## Work State
### Completed
- Compared local Playground refs with `origin/rescued/playground/*`; documented unpublished refs blocked by GitHub App workflow permissions in `docs/RESCUE_PLAYGROUND.md`.
- Updated theoretical system profitability to estimate seeds, electricity, water, nutrients, and labor, and clarified assumptions and exclusions in the UI.
- Verified `node --check` for `js/game.js`, `js/data.js`, and `js/world.js`, and `git diff --check`.
- Opened HydroHarvest in Playwright, started a farm, and inspected the dashboard, lab, and profitability tab; key screens rendered with zero console errors.

### Active
- Continue improving HydroHarvest as an educational business sandbox; review and iterate on learning and simulation features.
- Push current changes if repository permissions allow.

### Blocked
- 15 Playground refs remain unpublished because their trees contain `.github/workflows/opencode.yml` and the GitHub App lacks workflow permission; source refs remain local as `playground/*`.
- `https://github.com/gamer-frog/Hydro.git` returned `Repository not found`; the intended Hydro source remains unidentified.

## Next Move
1. Continue browser verification of core interactions and investigate the four browser console warnings if relevant.
2. Review and iterate on learning and business-simulation features.
3. Push the current changes if repository permissions allow.

## Relevant Files
- `js/game.js`: simulation, economy, advisor, and UI logic; contains the uncommitted profitability update.
- `js/data.js`: hydroponic system and crop data.
- `js/world.js`: Three.js scene and system visuals.
- `index.html`: current Spanish app interface.
- `css/style.css`: app styling and mobile layout.
- `docs/RESCUE_PLAYGROUND.md`: recovery provenance and blocked branch refs.
- `docs/history/`: archived project conversations and requirements.
- `archive/hydroharvest-v1/`: archived modular checkpoint 2 app.

## Important Context
- `js/game.js` and `docs/RESCUE_PLAYGROUND.md` are modified and uncommitted; nothing was pushed.
- Current app is HydroHarvest checkpoint 23. Theoretical profitability excludes greenhouse structure, packaging, logistics, taxes, and losses; payback uses only bed cost.
- A local preview server is running at `http://localhost:3002`; browser verification showed zero errors and four warnings.
- Git remotes: `origin=https://github.com/gamer-frog/Hydro_simulator`, `playground=https://github.com/gamer-frog/PlayGround.git`.

## Objective
- Develop HydroHarvest into a Spanish-language learning and visual sandbox for building an NFT hydroponics business and related systems.
- Preserve recovered project history and improve the app iteratively in “Modo Ralph loop.”

## Requirements
- Teach and visualize systems, variants, costs, materials, yields, customers, and profitability.
- Preserve recovered branches and push progress where possible.

## Decisions
- Use `gamer-frog/PlayGround` as the recovery source and preserve its branches under `rescued/playground/*` where permissions allow.
- Keep the checkpoint 2 modular version archived separately from the current root app.

## Work State
### Completed
- Compared local Playground refs with `origin/rescued/playground/*`; documented unpublished refs blocked by GitHub App workflow permissions in `docs/RESCUE_PLAYGROUND.md`.
- Updated theoretical system profitability to estimate seeds, electricity, water, nutrients, and labor, and clarified assumptions and exclusions in the UI.
- Verified `node --check` for `js/game.js`, `js/data.js`, and `js/world.js`, and `git diff --check`.
- Opened HydroHarvest in Playwright, started a farm, and inspected the dashboard, lab, and profitability tab; key screens rendered with zero console errors. The four warnings were WebGL GPU stall/`ReadPixels` performance warnings.

### Active
- Continue improving HydroHarvest as an educational business sandbox; review and iterate on learning and simulation features.
- Push current changes if repository permissions allow.

### Blocked
- 15 Playground refs remain unpublished because their trees contain `.github/workflows/opencode.yml` and the GitHub App lacks workflow permission; source refs remain local as `playground/*`.
- `https://github.com/gamer-frog/Hydro.git` returned `Repository not found`; the intended Hydro source remains unidentified.

## Next Move
1. Continue browser verification of core interactions and address performance warnings only if relevant.
2. Review and iterate on learning and business-simulation features.
3. Push the current changes if repository permissions allow.

## Relevant Files
- `js/game.js`: simulation, economy, advisor, and UI logic; contains uncommitted profitability changes.
- `js/data.js`: hydroponic system and crop data.
- `js/world.js`: Three.js scene and system visuals.
- `index.html`: current Spanish app interface.
- `css/style.css`: app styling and mobile layout.
- `docs/RESCUE_PLAYGROUND.md`: recovery provenance and blocked branch refs.
- `docs/history/`: archived project conversations and requirements.
- `archive/hydroharvest-v1/`: archived modular checkpoint 2 app.

## Important Context
- `js/game.js` and `docs/RESCUE_PLAYGROUND.md` are modified and uncommitted; nothing was pushed.
- Current app is HydroHarvest checkpoint 23. Theoretical profitability excludes greenhouse structure, packaging, logistics, taxes, and losses; payback uses only bed cost.
- A local preview server is running at `http://localhost:3002`. Browser verification showed zero errors; console warnings were GPU stalls during WebGL rendering.
- Git remotes: `origin=https://github.com/gamer-frog/Hydro_simulator`, `playground=https://github.com/gamer-frog/PlayGround.git`.

📐 2 · Modo plano

El botón 📐 activa el plano técnico: grilla en metros, medidas del invernadero, contadores de tubos y plantas por cama, y etiquetas con días para cosechar. Es la vista para entender la geometría real de cada sistema.

💧 3 · Cuidado semana a semana

Cada cama muestra su checklist semanal: medir pH/EC, rellenar, revisar raíces y un chequeo propio del sistema. Completar tareas da salud y crecimiento. Mantené pH 5,5–6,5 y EC dentro de la banda del cultivo. El Auto-Dosificador automatiza medición y relleno.

278:

📅 4 · Tiempo y cosecha

Los cultivos duran 2 a 6 semanas (1 semana = 7 días de juego). El panel de la cama muestra el cronograma con la semana actual y los días que faltan para cosechar. El Panel temporal (P) suma gráficos de caja, kilos cosechados, un Gantt de todas las camas y un registro de eventos.

279:

280:

## Objective
- Develop HydroHarvest into a Spanish-language learning and visual sandbox for building an NFT hydroponics business and related systems.
- Preserve recovered project history and improve the app iteratively in “Modo Ralph loop.”

## Requirements
- Teach and visualize systems, variants, costs, materials, yields, customers, and profitability.
- Preserve recovered branches and push progress where possible.

## Decisions
- Use `gamer-frog/PlayGround` as the recovery source and preserve its branches under `rescued/playground/*` where permissions allow.
- Keep the checkpoint 2 modular version archived separately from the current root app.

## Work State
### Completed
- Compared local Playground refs with `origin/rescued/playground/*`; documented unpublished refs blocked by GitHub App workflow permissions in `docs/RESCUE_PLAYGROUND.md`.
- Updated theoretical system profitability to estimate seeds, electricity, water, nutrients, and labor, and clarified assumptions and exclusions in the UI.
- Added expandable annual operating-cost breakdowns for seeds, energy, water, nutrients, and labor in the theoretical profitability table.
- Verified `node --check` for `js/game.js`, `js/data.js`, and `js/world.js`, and `git diff --check`.
- Opened HydroHarvest in Playwright, started a farm, and inspected the dashboard, lab, and profitability tab; prior screens rendered with zero console errors. Four WebGL GPU stall/`ReadPixels` performance warnings were observed.

### Active
- Continue improving HydroHarvest as an educational business sandbox; review and iterate on learning and simulation features.
- Verify the newly added cost breakdown in a refreshed browser session.
- Push current changes if repository permissions allow.

### Blocked
- 15 Playground refs remain unpublished because their trees contain `.github/workflows/opencode.yml` and the GitHub App lacks workflow permission; source refs remain local as `playground/*`.
- `https://github.com/gamer-frog/Hydro.git` returned `Repository not found`; the intended Hydro source remains unidentified.

## Next Move
1. Refresh the browser and verify the new “Ver desglose” controls and cost categories in the profitability table.
2. Continue reviewing learning and business-simulation features.
3. Push current changes if repository permissions allow.

## Relevant Files
- `js/game.js`: simulation, economy, advisor, and UI logic; contains uncommitted profitability changes and operating-cost breakdown.
- `js/data.js`: hydroponic system and crop data.
- `js/world.js`: Three.js scene and system visuals.
- `index.html`: current Spanish app interface.
- `css/style.css`: app styling; contains uncommitted cost-breakdown styles.
- `docs/RESCUE_PLAYGROUND.md`: recovery provenance and blocked branch refs.
- `docs/history/`: archived project conversations and requirements.
- `archive/hydroharvest-v1/`: archived modular checkpoint 2 app.

## Important Context
- `js/game.js`, `css/style.css`, and `docs/RESCUE_PLAYGROUND.md` have uncommitted changes; nothing was pushed.
- The most recent Playwright snapshot showed the previously open profitability view, without the new breakdown content, so the latest UI changes still need browser verification.
- Current app is HydroHarvest checkpoint 23. Theoretical profitability excludes greenhouse structure, packaging, logistics, taxes, and losses; payback uses only bed cost.
- A local preview server is running at `http://localhost:3002`; the earlier browser verification had zero errors, with WebGL GPU performance warnings.
